limitations: Native texture noise is retained; equal vertex positions or material names alone do not establish equal surface colour.
The baseline contains four mouths; private rejected proof01 has three saved mouth models, so its results cover only those three.
Boundary samples and seam samples are bounded tests, not continuous colour-field, full-road, visibility, or all-camera proofs.
The native shoulder is constant RGB, whereas safe lane edges vary by several channel levels; equal-grey boundaries are not asserted.
No game result, manual observation, or accepted final colour-revision result is recorded here.

method.V_phase_difference: Wrapped difference in texture-repeat units; subtracting an integer repeat has no texture effect.
method.baseline_seam: Seven s offsets (-3,-2,-1,0,1,2,3 m) around each actual car-path seam, sampled at q=8±0.00002 m.
method.coordinate_frame: Same independently measured four-mouth outward s/q frames as native-marking-measurements.json; q=8 m is the native-deck/authored-ramp seam.
method.path_centre: Intersection of actual decoded, placed car PATH segments with q=8; no theoretical side swap supplies the seam position.
method.rejected_proof_inner_edge: Samples at q=4.5±0.0001 m and selected taper/parallel s stations; the hypothetical inner boundary is measured before accepting any corridor design.
method.surface_selection: Actual indexed, placed, horizontal saved S3D pavement faces at deck height 7.5 m or 15 m; authored paint at deck+0.01 m is excluded.
method.texture_sampling: Decode the first native FSH image, retain RGBA image orientation, use repeat wrapping and bilinear texel-centre sampling (128*U-0.5,128*V-0.5), and report unlit RGB channel values. This is a software sampling convention, not a game-rendering observation.

central_track_exact_correspondence.scope: Central asphalt trough only; a universal +16 mapping over paint and shoulders is not asserted.

privacy: Private source/archive paths and private proof locations are omitted; resource IDs, hashes, numerical samples, and measured results are retained.
purpose: Independent numerical review of native pavement tyre-track continuity and a rejected private texture-coordinate proof.

rejected_private_proof_01.reason: Although the native-deck/ramp q=8 seam improves, the hard q>=4.5 m inner cutoff creates a new abrupt dark boundary at unpainted positions beside the separator.

review_targets_for_next_proof.target_kind: Proposed bounded software acceptance limits; not results for a later candidate.
